paper.title: Solving the Wind Farm Layout Optimization Problem Using Random Search Algorithm
paper.authors: Ju Feng and Wen Zhong Shen

target_contributions: Algorithm-1 improved continuous random search that reuses the turbine and direction of an accepted move
one-moved-turbine wake-influence tensor update instead of complete tensor reconstruction
three ideal and three Horns Rev fixed-count layout-optimization problems
12-versus-72-versus-360 directional preprocessing and Case-1 robustness analysis
non_target_baselines: published GA and old-RS results are external comparison anchors and are not T60 target methods

source_assets.author_source: no paper-linked author source located; paper reports private Fortran 95

used_fields: Vestas V80 2 MW power and thrust-coefficient tables
same_lineage_public_source.authority: same-lineage public completion and independent cross-check; not target-author source

wind: 36 directions by 8, 12 and 17 m/s Figure-derived joint weights

case_definitions: measured Table-3 wind and original parallelogram
constructed 300-degree-dominant Table-3 wind and original parallelogram
measured Table-3 wind and boundary enlarged by 7D in both affine dimensions

problem_contract.decision_variables: continuous x,y coordinates for a fixed number of identical turbines
problem_contract.objective: maximize expected total wind-farm power; fixed turbine count makes this identical to minimizing the paper CoE
problem_contract.wake: target Eqs. (4)-(9), Jensen/PARK expansion, analytic partial rotor overlap and RSS deficit superposition

horns_rev.original_boundary: affine hull u in [0,9], v in [0,7] of the public 10-by-8 7D layout
horns_rev.wind_speed_quadrature: 0.5 m/s midpoint bins over [0,30] with normalized Weibull mass
horns_rev.power_and_ct: linear interpolation of pinned public V80 tables

optimizer_contract.when_previous_move_failed: choose a turbine uniformly, a direction uniformly on [0,2pi), and a step uniformly on [0,long edge]
optimizer_contract.when_previous_move_improved: reuse the accepted turbine and direction and draw a new uniform step
optimizer_contract.infeasible_move: repeat Random Move without consuming a complete-layout physical FES; clear remembered-ray mode because the paper leaves permanently outward rays undefined
optimizer_contract.missing_sampler_completion: ideal uses continuous rejection placement; Horns uses bounded affine stratified jitter

conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: target Figure 1 visibly uses a 4000 m square and 400 m lattice, while the cited benchmark is frequently represented as 2000 m and 200 m
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use the target paper's 80 m rotor and 4000 m dimensionally equivalent scaling

conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: the paper says the data were extracted from a predecessor figure but supplies no array
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use the platform-audited Mosetti/Grady Figure-derived 36-by-3 joint weights

conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: Figure 2 and Table 3 do not provide coordinate or turbine arrays
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use pinned same-lineage public PyWake coordinates and V80 tables; retain Table-3 wind values from the target paper

conflicts_and_resolutions.field: random step and random feasible start
conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: only random direction, random bounded step and random feasible layout are stated
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: use uniform laws and deterministic declared feasible samplers

conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: Algorithm 1 says to repeat Random Move but an accepted boundary move can leave the remembered positive ray with no feasible step
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: clear the improve flag after an infeasible proposal and return to the random branch, matching the platform reconstruction of the cited predecessor

conflicts_and_resolutions.paper_fact: the boundary is enlarged by 7D in two main parallelogram directions without numeric vertices
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: add one 7D interval to each affine dimension, split equally between both sides

hpc_contract.H0: derive the pairwise geometric influence, expected-power integration, feasibility and Algorithm-1 data dependencies
hpc_contract.H1: structure-of-arrays direction profiles and fixed affine geometry
hpc_contract.H2: preintegrate each wind-speed profile into a dense squared-influence-to-power lookup and approximate analytic overlap through a precision-validated table
hpc_contract.H3: update the moved turbine's source column and target row in O(S*N), instead of O(S*N*N), and check moved-turbine feasibility in O(N)
hpc_contract.H4: parallelize fixed-layout wind directions and schedule independent trajectories over one persistent worker team
hpc_contract.H5: independent equations, exact versus lookup precision, incremental versus full equality, complete case matrix and exact physical-FES tests
hpc_contract.H6: one-worker versus all-core science identity, evaluator/full-recompute speedup and full-core campaign speedup
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: use all 20 Waffle CPU cores without nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: source-backed flexible academic reproduction of every target problem, target algorithm, lifecycle, repeat matrix, preprocessing probe and robustness family; not author source, native random state, unavailable arrays or exact-number replay
